verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical at this banner size, so they share the same flaws. The plan cards are out of order (6, 80, then the dark 48 card, where the original goes Monthly, Yearly, Family), so the featured Yearly plan gets pushed to the edge. The card labels, 'per month' text, subhead and legal line are all far too small to read. The left column is cramped next to the headline, though the headline and orange CTA do read clearly and the brand survives.
